reviewer.purpose: Qualitative triage only; this does not replace the user's blind review.

method.decision_rule: The adapter would need at least 7 of 11 holdout preferences and no broad instruction-adherence or factuality regression to advance.

case_reviews.notes: A is a coherent, quiet scene with concrete details. B contains malformed phrasing and confusing invented details.
Both responses discuss how to revise instead of directly revising the note, and both invent placeholder reasons and dates.
B follows the staff routine, discarded-object, and physical-ending constraints directly. A is more abstract and ends less decisively.
Both are meta-level option menus rather than a direct notice. B is shorter and more actionable, but still uses unsupported placeholders.
B meets the requested length and supplies a repeated routine and object. A is too short and includes awkward, unclear wording.
B is a more coherent comic monologue with a practical problem and absurd plan. A is vivid but overinflated and less controlled.
B makes the frightened request and dropped-object interruption clearer; both satisfy the unexplained escape.
B gives the small exchange a clearer comic shape and more specific social observation.
B uses more concrete behavior and circumstance. Both lean on generic contrast language, but B is more grounded.
A includes an actual mishap and an open invitation. B keeps the exchange open but only anticipates the mishap.
A layers water, plant, and machine sound more coherently and ends with the requested brief reaction. B has a confusing shore/boat relationship.
